question: A medicine has 60% substance S and 40% substance T. If the cost price of S is increased from ₹30 to ₹40 per unit and the cost price of T is decreased to ₹20 from ₹30 per unit, then the cost of the medicine will _____ by _____%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change per unit = (Proportion of S × Change in S) + (Proportion of T × Change in T)

Net change = (60% × +10) + (40% × −10) = +6 − 4 = +₹2

Initial average cost per unit = (60% × 30) + (40% × 30) = ₹30

Percentage increase = (Net change ÷ Initial cost) × 100

Percentage increase = (2 ÷ 30) × 100 ≈ 6.67%

**∴ The correct answer is increase by 6.67%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Composition: Substance S = 60%, Substance T = 40%

Initial cost of S = ₹30/unit, Initial cost of T = ₹30/unit

New cost of S = ₹40/unit, New cost of T = ₹20/unit

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Change = [(Final Cost − Initial Cost) ÷ Initial Cost] × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total quantity of the medicine be 100 units.

⇒ Quantity of S = 60 units, Quantity of T = 40 units

⇒ Initial cost = (60 × 30) + (40 × 30)

⇒ Initial cost = 1800 + 1200 = ₹3000

⇒ New cost = (60 × 40) + (40 × 20)

⇒ New cost = 2400 + 800 = ₹3200

⇒ Increase in cost = 3200 − 3000 = ₹200

⇒ Percentage increase = (200 ÷ 3000) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 20 ÷ 3 ≈ 6.67%

**∴ The correct answer is increase by 6.67%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

Percentage change represents the degree of change over time, calculated as the ratio of the difference to the original value, multiplied by 100. Formula: % Change = (Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value × 100.

Weighted Average

It calculates the average of a set of values where each value carries a different weight or proportion. Formula: Average = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂).

Alligation Rule

Alligation is an arithmetic method used to compute the average price or composition when two or more ingredients at given prices or concentrations are mixed together.
